claim_boundary: This contract proves only that the current molecular-HNC scalar refuses a bulk source generated by another closure and records one deterministic HNC water source. It is not a production molecular liquid, a pressure-corrected solvation free energy, a force/PES result, a multi-solvent asset admission, or an accuracy result.

mathematical_identity.functional: Omega_HNC[nu] = Omega_id[nu; u_MACE] - (kBT/2)
mathematical_identity.implementation_gate: Route2V0MaceClusterRismMolecularHNCBridge and build_route2_v0_asset_bound_rism_kernel reject any frozen asset whose declared closure is not HNC before assembling a kernel or a bridge.
mathematical_identity.selection_rule: HNC was selected from the already implemented scalar identity before any target-solvation score. It was not chosen by MNSol, FreeSolv, development, confirmation, blind, or other experimental solvation error.

pse_n_boundary.reason_rejected_by_current_bridge: PSE-n/KH closures have their own path-independent excess-chemical-potential expressions. A PSE3 direct correlation cannot be silently inserted into the molecular-HNC scalar merely because the site model, temperature, and Coulomb convention match.
pse_n_boundary.future_rule: A future PSE-n or KH branch must preregister, implement, and finite-difference certify a matched configuration-space scalar, its source closure, pressure/standard-state convention, and all force terms before it can consume a PSE-n/KH source. It may not bypass this gate or select a closure from target errors.

literature.title: Free Energies from Integral Equation Theories: Enforcing Path Independence
Solvation Thermodynamics of Organic Molecules by the Molecular Integral Equation Theory: Approaching Chemical Accuracy

hnc_source.generation: two independent AmberTools 26.0 DRISM/HNC bulk rism1d runs at 298 K with the source-fixed cSPC/E model, 0.025 Angstrom radial spacing, 16384 points, SMEAR=1, and residual tolerance 1e-12
hnc_source.source_complete_only: The HNC source passes content hashes, two-run normalized-XVV reproduction, Cvv reproduction, self-test identity, neutral bulk metadata, and its predeclared Coulomb-tail gate. It still lacks production Cartesian/orientation convergence, a physically certified molecular liquid/bridge/EOS/standard-state endpoint, ten further solvents, and chemistry maximum-error evidence.

decision_rule: A closure mismatch, source hash mismatch, failed two-run reproduction, failed residual/self-test/tail gate, missing physical liquid gate, missing default-solvent assets, or any later structural or per-record accuracy failure rejects the candidate. No response tuning, cavity/radius adjustment, pressure correction fit, closure search against solvation labels, post-training, or fine-tuning is authorized.
